items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What kind of man was Johnny Dodds? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, he was wonderful. Nice and quiet.

ctx.x: One of the sessions the band -- the session that you recorded "The Pearls," according to the discographies, that was the same date that Jelly made a couple of trio sides with Johnny and Baby Dodds?
